title: FanOutRoster
description: DSL 3.1 preview roster document a map freezes before any item starts. Each entry runs the mapped task once. Duplicate identities and mismatched digests are rejected when the runner freezes the document.

items.description: Roster entries. The runner sorts them by identity, bytewise UTF-8, before execution. An empty array enters the join once.

identity.description: Stable author-chosen item identity, used for ordering, display and branch-scoped names.

item.description: Item payload bound into the mapped task through the item binding.

digest.description: Optional SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 serialization of {identity, item}. The runner always computes it and requires a supplied value to match.
